item.title: Leicestershire Records Wettest Winter On Record
item.description: Leicestershire has experienced its wettest winter on record according to provisional figures from the Met Office. item.title: Forensic Spray Plan to Tackle Illegal Off-Road Bikes
item.description: Police in Desborough are exploring the use of forensic spray to crack down on illegal off-road motorbike riding.
